features.name: The flange's outer face, proud of the high side face
The flange: an annulus round the finger
Raise the flange along the band's high edge
Raise the rim's roll, its arrises chamfered
Sink the second order half as deep
The flange's face, lifted clear of the metal
One bay of the wheel: a lancet on its spokes and the quatrefoil beside its head
Pierce the bay through the flange and the band
Wheel the bay round the finger

process: neither clean at the draft check

notes: Field-sampled: the surface itself carries no undercut at this parting.
Judged with the ring as built: 8 CAD parts (3 joined, 5 cut) at the parting plane z = +0.00 mm — 2160.4 mm² of part surface, 422.6 mm² of it undercut.

Extrude "Raise the flange along the band's high edge" (#4): 328.3 mm² of undercut leaning to -90° on its drag-facing flank above the parting plane, 70–69°, 1.2–3.3 mm toward the high edge — stage it Bench to solder it on after the pour (the pattern keeps a locating mark), or move it onto the parting line.

Extrude "Raise the rim's roll, its arrises chamfered" (#6): 44.9 mm² of undercut leaning to -90° on its drag-facing flank above the parting plane, 59–241°, 3.3–3.3 mm toward the high edge — stage it Bench to solder it on after the pour (the pattern keeps a locating mark), or move it onto the parting line.

Extrude "Raise the hub's roll" (#8): 24.1 mm² of undercut leaning to -90° on its drag-facing flank above the parting plane, 58–242°, 3.3–3.3 mm toward the high edge — stage it Bench to solder it on after the pour (the pattern keeps a locating mark), or move it onto the parting line.

Extrude "Pierce the bay through the flange and the band" (#15): 0.4 mm² of undercut leaning to -90° on the hole's walls facing down above the parting plane, 97–102°, 1.2–1.2 mm toward the high edge — drill it at the bench: stage it Bench and the pattern keeps a raised drill mark at its centre.

Extrude "Splay the bay's arrises" (#18): 1.1 mm² of undercut leaning to -90° on the hole's walls facing down above the parting plane, 81–99°, 2.8–2.8 mm toward the high edge — drill it at the bench: stage it Bench and the pattern keeps a raised drill mark at its centre.

Ring array "Wheel the bay round the finger" (#19): 23.9 mm² of undercut leaning to -90° on the hole's walls either side of the parting plane, 102–82°, 3.0 mm toward the low edge to 3.1 mm toward the high edge — drill it at the bench: stage it Bench and the pattern keeps a raised drill mark at its centre.
With its CAD parts 33.5% of the ring carries less than 3.0 deg of draft or stands parallel to the pull — it releases, but drags on the sand.

summary: 6 x 2.6 band with one 2.4 mm flange on its high edge out to r 17.0 (7.7 mm of run): 18 lancets on 1.1 mm spokes with splayed arrises, 18 quatrefoils 1.4 mm across, the field sunk 0.6 in two orders inside a chamfered rim roll and a hub roll.
